contexts.text: Fine linen, etc. () = Knowledges of good.
Under Embroider, see this reference. AC 5319:3. AC 5620:4. AC 5954:6. AC 9688:3.
Its lower spiritual things, and doctrinal things, are garments of broidered work, of fine linen, of silk ().
Clothed in fine linen, white and clean () = the same in love and faith thence. ( = the same in truth from good. WH 1:2.)

Clothed him in garments of fine linen () = an external significative of the Celestial of the Spiritual. Garments of fine linen = truths from the Divine... For a garment of fine linen was bright white and at the same time resplendent; and truth from the Divine is represented by garments of such shining whiteness and brilliance; the reason being that the shining whiteness and brilliance of Heaven are from the light which is from the Lord. Illustrated.
Fine linen and garments of fine linen, in other parts of the Word, also = truth from the Divine. Illustrated.
Fine linen () = natural truths; and silk, spiritual truths.

The reason why fine linen is the righteousness of the saints (), is that all those who are in truth from the Divine put on the Lord's righteousness; for their garments are shining white and brilliant by virtue of the light which is from the Lord.
That truth from the Divine might be represented in the Jewish Church, it was commanded that there should be fine linen in the garments of Aaron, and also in the curtains about the ark. Illustrated.

That the Angels who are in truth from the Divine appear clothed as in fine linen, that is, in brilliant shining whiteness, is evident from ; from which it is very evident that fine linen is an external significative of truth from the Divine...
Fine linen and silk () = truths from good; (because) in the light of Heaven these are most resplendent and are transparent.

Purple and fine linen () = the Knowledges of good and truth from the Word. (The fine linen = the Knowledges of truth... from a celestial origin, because from the Divine. AC 9467:5. AE 1042:4.) ( = genuine truth. AC 10227:20.) ( = the truth of the Word. DSS 40:3.)

Fine linen thread () = the truth thence derived... Fine linen = truth from the Divine; both = truth in the natural man. Fine linen thread = truth from a celestial origin on account of its whiteness and softness.
Fine linen woven together () = truth from a celestial origin... In the Second Heaven this truth is first... But in the veil the fine linen woven together is mentioned last. Explained. AC 9671.
But by fine linen woven together is properly signified the Intellectual as it is with the spiritual... and therefore spiritual truth is also signified.
See Blue.

Of fine linen woven together () = from the Intellectual. (For) fine linen = truth from a, celestial origin; and therefore fine linen woven together = the Intellectual; because this consists and is as it were woven of truths from a celestial origin... So far, therefore, as the understanding is formed from genuine truths, it excels, and is fine linen woven together; for fine linen = truth from the Divine.
Fine linen = the truth of spiritual love. (Therefore it was woven into the ephod.)

The reason fine linen was not interwoven (in the robe) as in the ephod, is that the coat, which was the inmost garment, was of fine linen, and this because fine linen = truth from a celestial origin, which is spiritual good itself proceeding from the Celestial.
Under Coat, see this reference. CL 20:2. CL 266.
Thou shalt make the mitre of fine linen () = wisdom there... Fine linen = truth from a celestial origin; for from this truth comes the wisdom here signified by the mitre...
Fine linen = intellectual truth which is from the Divine. References.
In the Heavens where wisdom reigns the light is shining white, and the Angels there are clothed in white garments of fine linen.
Three Angels in fine linen were seen...
Fine linen, etc. () = in general, celestial goods and truths.

It was given her to be arrayed in fine linen clean and bright () = that those who will be of the Lord's New Church are instructed by the Lord in genuine and pure truths through the Word... Fine linen clean and bright = shining from good and pure from truths; and as pure truth is given only through the Word from the Lord, this, too, is signified. It is called clean and bright, because clean = that which is free from evil, thus which shines from good; and bright = that which is free from falsity, thus which is pure from truth. AE 1222.
By fine linen is signified genuine truth. Illustrated.
Fine linen is the righteousness of the saints () = that by truths from the Word there are goods of life with those who are of the Lord's Church. AE 1223.

The armies in Heaven followed Him upon white horses, clothed in fine linen white and clean () = the Angels in the New Christian Heaven, who were conjoined with the Lord in the interior understanding of the Word, and thus in pure and genuine truths... Fine linen white and clean = pure and genuine truth through the Word from the Lord. (As this was before said of the New Church, so it is here said of the New Heaven.)
Garments of fine linen in Heaven. CL 75:4.
They who have been regenerated by means of the Divine truth of faith, in Heaven go in white garments of fine linen; and are called spiritual Angels.
Fine linen = genuine truth. References. AE 236:9. AE 242:15.
Fine linen and silk = truths from a celestial origin.
Fine linen = truth from a celestial origin; silk, truth from a spiritual origin; and embroidery, truth from a natural origin.
Fine linen () = spiritual truth.
The spiritual Angels are clothed in garments of fine linen and silk; in general, resplendent ones.
The Angels who are wise from Divine truth appear in white garments of satin, fine linen, or linen, because these three correspond to the truths in which they are. Illustrated.
Of fine linen and of crimson () = truths and goods from a celestial origin profaned. AE 1143:2, Illustrated. AE 1166.
The reason fine linen = truth from a celestial origin, is that fine linen was a kind of very bright linen, of which garments were made...
As truth from a celestial origin is truth Divine, which is all from the Lord, and is the Word, by fine linen is signified truth from the Word... AE 1223.
